text: // Add MonthStart and MonthEnd (for stable month-axis behavior)
unapplied_queries.lastLoadedAsTableFormulaText:
{"IncludesReferencedQueries":false,"RootFormulaText":"let
    Source = Databricks.Catalogs(environment_server_name, environment_http_path, [Catalog=environment_catalog, Database=null, EnableAutomaticProxyDiscovery=null]),
    prod_Database = Source{[Name="prod",Kind="Database"]}[Data],
    conformed_v_Schema = prod_Database{[Name="conformed_v",Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    dim_date_v_View = conformed_v_Schema{[Name="dim_date_v",Kind="View"]}[Data],

    // Add numeric YearMonth (YYYYMM)
    Added_YearMonth = Table.AddColumn(
        dim_date_v_View,
        "YearMonth",
        each Date.Year([date]) * 100 + Date.Month([date]),
        Int64.Type
    ),

    // Add readable YearMonth label (e.g. "Jan 2026")
    Added_YearMonth_Label = Table.AddColumn(
        Added_YearMonth,
        "YearMonth Label",
        each Date.ToText([date], "MMM yyyy"),
        type text
    ),

    // Add MonthStart and MonthEnd (for stable month-axis behavior)
    Added_MonthStart = Table.AddColumn(
        Added_YearMonth_Label,
        "MonthStart",
        each Date.StartOfMonth([date]),
        type date
    ),

    Added_MonthEnd = Table.AddColumn(
        Added_MonthStart,
        "MonthEnd",
        each Date.EndOfMonth([date]),
        type date
    )

in
    Added_MonthEnd","ReferencedQueriesFormulaText":{}}
